text:
Nadia: Noticed an uptick in SSE disconnects flagged as client_timeout starting 2026-05-17T14:45Z. But traces show proxy sent a 204 keepalive immediately before a routing change.

otto: Yup. Client sees 204 -> treats as terminal. When slab manager flips target in <100ms, resume fails with mismatch and clients open fresh sessions.

Lena: Sample sanitized logs:

`2026-05-17T14:45:02.981Z route=svc-12 slab=slab-9 session=aa1 conn_status=204 keepalive=true`
`2026-05-17T14:45:03.058Z route=svc-12 slab=slab-11 resume_attempt=1 resume_ok=false reason="session_mismatch"`

ara: Root cause: slab manager sets `draining=true` but keepalive path still returns 204. We need the proxy to annotate soft closes when routing state is unstable so client libs can preserve resume_id and retry.

Nadia: Billing flagged ~1.8k duplicate session charges. We should add a short meter grace window (defaults: 750ms) where reconnections with same resume_id aren't billed as new sessions. Make it opt-in per account.

billing-bot: Incident INC-2026-492 created for duplicate metering; severity P3.

otto: Proposal: proxy emits `X-Routing-State: transitioning` header on keepalive when slab flagged draining; also log `routing_transition=true slab_change_id=...`. Console can then correlate reconnect spikes with rollout metadata.

Lena: UI ask: on the reconnect alert show `canary_pct`, `drain_slabs`, and `slab_change_id` so oncall can quickly tell if rollouts are the cause.

ara: I'll open PR to add header+log flag and include a backcompat env toggle. Adding unit tests. ETA ~40m.

Nadia: Action list: 1) @ara add header+logs, 2) @Lena add dashboard panel to correlate `routing_transition` with `conn_status` and `resume_ok`, 3) @billing-bot (Sam) prototype meter grace window opt-in, 4) DevEx add guidance for client libs to treat `X-Routing-State` as resume-friendly.

otto: Also suggest a console filter `handoff_hint=planned` vs `handoff_hint=unknown` so we can silence rollout noise.

Lena: Will add the panel and create alert rule to include rollout metadata in the alert payload.

Nadia: If churn spikes again I'll flip the canary. Ping me immediately.
